description: Held-out catalog-search queries written by reading data/netflix_titles.csv only. No retriever was run, and this file has no relevance labels. Labels are assigned later from a blinded pool. The 28 queries in data/labeled_queries.json stay the dev set (same query text, new labels).

queries.query: sci-fi anthology series about technology going wrong
queries.notes: Genre paraphrase. Near-future technology anthology, not a single-plot space film.

queries.query: adult cartoon about a washed-up sitcom star
queries.notes: Genre plus tone. Adult animation about a faded celebrity, not a preschool cartoon.

queries.query: horror movie about hidden cameras in a rental house
queries.notes: Genre plus a concrete horror premise.

queries.query: makeover reality show that restyles someone's life
queries.notes: Reality-TV genre paraphrase. Lifestyle makeover, not a scripted drama.

queries.query: anime movie about a girl who turns into a cat
queries.notes: Anime feature with a transformation premise.

queries.query: dystopian film about a violent young man forced into behavioral therapy
queries.notes: Genre paraphrase of a classic dystopian satire.

queries.query: drama about a marriage falling apart
queries.notes: Plot paraphrase. A couple separating, not a romantic comedy.

queries.query: anime about a former bully making amends to a deaf classmate
queries.notes: Specific plot. Redemption story, not a general deafness documentary.

queries.query: documentary about gymnasts abused by a team doctor
queries.notes: Topical documentary paraphrase. Abuse in gymnastics, not a sports biopic.

queries.query: drama about a teenager transitioning and their family
queries.notes: Plot plus family drama. Scripted film, not a news documentary.

queries.query: series about teenagers falsely accused of an attack in Central Park
queries.notes: True-story plot. The wrongful-conviction dramatization, not a generic crime show.

queries.query: documentary about a sports doping conspiracy
queries.notes: Investigative sports documentary. Doping scandal, not a race-series docuseries.

queries.query: Adam Sandler comedy movie
queries.notes: Person plus genre. Comedy films, not a stand-up special unless the special is the work itself.

queries.query: John Mulaney stand-up comedy special
queries.notes: Exact performer name plus stand-up format.

queries.query: Shah Rukh Khan romantic Bollywood movie
queries.notes: Person plus genre and industry. Romantic films, not every title that merely mentions the name.

queries.query: Martin Scorsese crime film with Robert De Niro
queries.notes: Two people plus crime. A crime film those two made together, not every Scorsese or De Niro title.

queries.query: Jerry Seinfeld stand-up comedy special
queries.notes: Exact performer name plus stand-up special. Not the sitcom and not a talk show.

queries.query: Marie Kondo home organization show
queries.notes: Person plus format. Home-organization series, not a generic cleaning gag.

queries.query: British gangster series set after the First World War
queries.notes: Country and era. Post-World War I Britain, not a World War II documentary.

queries.query: drama series about Queen Elizabeth II
queries.notes: Era and subject. A dramatized series about her reign, not a one-off royal tribute documentary.

queries.query: Indian crime series set in Mumbai
queries.notes: Country and city. An Indian crime series in Mumbai, not a one-off Mumbai movie.

queries.query: series about Mexican drug cartels in the 1980s
queries.notes: Country and decade. A dramatized cartel series, not a stand-up special filmed in Mexico.

queries.query: Nigerian drama about a journalist exposing trafficking in Lagos
queries.notes: Country plus a specific plot. Lagos trafficking drama, not every Nigerian thriller.

queries.query: 1950s classic drama about a Southern family and a dying patriarch
queries.notes: Era plus plot. A 1950s classic, not a modern family drama.

queries.query: mockumentary sitcom about office workers at a paper company
queries.notes: Mixed genre and workplace premise. The paper-company mockumentary, not a Taiwanese office romance.

queries.query: series about a karate rivalry decades after a teen tournament
queries.notes: Mixed franchise sequel and premise. The later rivalry series, not the original teen movie.

queries.query: documentary about Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls
queries.notes: Mixed person and sports documentary. Jordan with the Bulls, not every basketball documentary.

queries.query: Regency-era romantic series about a London family
queries.notes: Mixed era, place, and romance genre.

queries.query: South Korean romance about a woman stranded in North Korea
queries.notes: Mixed country and plot. A romance across the border, not a war documentary.

queries.query: Indian police series about investigating a gang rape in Delhi
queries.notes: Mixed country, format, and a specific case. A police series, not a general Mumbai gangster show.
